edges.reason: Constructor parameter name flows into state variable _name.
Constructor parameter symbol flows into state variable _symbol.
Constructor parameter decimals flows into state variable _decimals.
Constructor parameter totalSupply defines the minted amount of the token.
Constructor parameter feeReceiver is the destination of the external value transfer.
Constructor parameter tokenOwnerAddress receives the whole minted supply.
Constructor writes the token name into _name.
Constructor writes the token symbol into _symbol.
Constructor writes the token decimals into _decimals.
Constructor invokes _mint to create the initial supply.
tokenOwnerAddress is passed as the mint beneficiary.
totalSupply is passed as the minted amount.
_mint credits the beneficiary entry of _balances.
_mint increases the stored _totalSupply.
feeReceiver is used as the recipient of the external transfer operation.
Constructor executes the external ETH transfer to an arbitrary feeReceiver before finishing.
The external value transfer may execute code of the attacker-controlled feeReceiver and re-enter the deployment flow.
burn uses msg.sender as the account whose balance is destroyed.
The value parameter is the amount passed to _burn.
burn delegates the destruction to _burn.
msg.sender is passed as the account argument of _burn.
The caller-supplied value flows into the _burn amount.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_burn performs supply and balance subtraction guarded only by SafeMath.
transfer implicitly uses msg.sender as the token source.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer delegates the balance move to _transfer.
msg.sender becomes the sender argument of _transfer.
recipient flows into _transfer as the destination.
amount flows into _transfer as the moved value.
_transfer rewrites the sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_transfer performs balance addition and subtraction on attacker-controlled amounts.

spender parameter is forwarded to _approve.
allowance amount parameter is forwarded to _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument of _approve.
spender flows into _approve.

recipient parameter is the delegation destination.
amount parameter is the transferred value.
msg.sender's allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.

transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.
sender flows into _transfer as the debited account.
sender flows into _approve as the allowance owner.

msg.sender owns the allowance being increased.
spender receives the increased allowance.

msg.sender owns the allowance being decreased.

normalization_plan.reason: The name parameter only exists to initialize _name in the constructor, so it collapses into the constructor node.
The symbol parameter only exists to initialize _symbol in the constructor, so it collapses into the constructor node.
The decimals parameter only exists to initialize _decimals in the constructor, so it collapses into the constructor node.
totalSupply is consumed by _mint as the minted amount, so it merges into the mint routine rather than being a standalone abstraction.
feeReceiver is the destination of the external value transfer, directly coupling the parameter to that unsafe operation.
tokenOwnerAddress is the beneficiary passed to _mint and has no independent semantics.
The value parameter is the sole input of burn and collapses into that function node.
recipient is a positional input of transfer/transferFrom and merges into the transfer function node.
amount drives the balance arithmetic performed by _transfer, so it merges into that routine.
spender is a positional input of approve and merges into the approve function node.
sender is a positional input of transferFrom and merges into that function node.
